functions.name: ping
functions.description: Return bridge diagnostics without changing messages.

functions.name: markMessage
functions.description: Mark a message read/unread and/or answered using Thunderbird's own database and IMAP flag sync.

parameters.name: read
parameters.description: Set the read state. Omit to leave it unchanged.

parameters.name: answered
parameters.description: When true, set the answered/replied flag.

parameters.name: accountKey
parameters.description: Restrict the lookup to this Thunderbird account key.

functions.name: diagnose
functions.description: Return diagnostic information about the bridge directories.

functions.name: touchStatus
functions.description: Write a heartbeat status file for the MCP bridge.

functions.name: takeCommands
functions.description: Return and delete pending commands from the profile bridge directory.

functions.name: writeResult
functions.description: Write a command result into the profile bridge directory.

functions.name: socketStart
functions.description: Start the Unix domain socket bridge. Returns a JSON string.

functions.name: socketStop
functions.description: Stop the Unix domain socket bridge. Returns a JSON string.

functions.name: socketStatus
functions.description: Return Unix socket bridge status as a JSON string.

functions.name: takeRequest
functions.description: Return the next queued socket request as a JSON string, or the string null.

functions.name: sendResponse
functions.description: Queue a JSON response for a socket connection. Returns a JSON string.
